Wu Huaqiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee and Vice President of Tsinghua University, and Zhang Yaqin, foreign academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering and Dean of the Institute for AI Industry Research at Tsinghua University, attended the event and delivered speeches. Liu Tieyan, President of Beijing Zhongguancun College, served as the conference chair and gave the welcome address. The conference also gathered top global scientific figures, including Serge Haroche, 2012 Nobel Laureate in Physics; Thomas J. Sargent, 2011 Nobel Laureate in Economics; and the 2013 Nobel Laureate.

items.title: Show HN: I built an interactive HN Simulator
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN! Just for fun, I built an interactive Hacker News Simulator. You can submit text posts and links, just like the real HN. But on HN Simulator, all of the comments are generated by LLMs + generate instantly. The best way to use it (IMHO) is to submit a text post or a curl-able URL here: https://news.ysimulator.run/submit . You don't need an account to post. When you do that, various prompts will be built from a library of commenter archetypes, moods, and shapes. The AI commenters will actually respond to your text post and/or submitted link. items.raw_excerpt: https://xcancel.com/karpathy/status/1993010584175141038

title_i18n.en: Implications of AI to schools

title_i18n.es: Implicaciones de la inteligencia artificial en los centros educativos

excerpt_i18n.en: https://xcancel.com/karpathy/status/1993010584175141038
excerpt_i18n.es: El 12 de mayo de 2024, el modelo de IA GPT-4o de OpenAI fue presentado al mundo. Es el primer modelo que combina texto, audio y visión en un solo sistema, capaz de razonar a través de cualquiera de estas modalidades de entrada o salida. Es rápido: responde a la entrada de audio en un promedio de 320 milisegundos, similar al tiempo de respuesta humano en una conversación. Es potente: obtiene un 88,7 % en el MMLU (comprensión de lenguaje multidisciplinario) y supera a los humanos en el examen de nivel básico de graduado. Y es gratuito para todos los usuarios, con límites de uso que aumentarán con el tiempo.
